issues.title: Mixed acceptance section and conditional clauses
issues.body:
## Exclusive mutable scope
- scripts/verify.ps1

## Acceptance criteria
- Only when verification profile Quick passes exit 0
- If crates/kernel is modified, require full clippy
- Where doc routing changes, run docs_router check
- Declared denominator: 2 cases, exactly 1..2.
1. Case one
2. Case two

## Must not modify
- Cargo.lock
